 Responsibility statements                                Currency risk – Owing to the international nature of the Rheinmetall Group’s business, certain
 Financial calendar and legal information                 operational currency risks arise from the fluctuating exchange rates between the functional
                                                          currencies of Group companies and other currencies. Open positions subject to currency risk
                                                          are generally hedged using derivative financial instruments. Currency forwards and swaps are
                                                          generally used for this purpose. Where legally possible, these are contracted between the
                                                          Rheinmetall Group companies and Rheinmetall AG. The resulting foreign currency position at
                                                          Rheinmetall AG is closed out via credit institutions, either directly or as part of a portfolio ap-
                                                          proach. The most important currency hedges in the Group refer to Swiss franc, US dollar, Aus-
                                                          tralian dollar, pound sterling and South African rand transactions. These hedging transactions
